sources.title: Jun Woo Cho et al.
sources.detail: Optical repumping of triplet P-states enhances magneto-optical trapping of ytterbium atoms
sources.referenceRole: 174Yb cascade effective-loss measurements; not direct fine-structure branching fractions
evidenceNotes: SecIII eliminates D manifolds; the rates are effective cascade flows. 3S1 1:3:5 is an assumed model, not measured precise beta.

sources.title: Jacob P. Covey et al.
sources.detail: Telecom-Band Quantum Optics with Ytterbium Atoms and Silicon Nanophotonics
sources.referenceRole: Cavity proposal and conflicting branching assumptions; not adopted as free-space canonical beta
evidenceNotes: PDF p8 AppendixA: fine-structure60:3:1 and state-specific20.9:1.9:1 differ substantially from Porsev/Kroeze64:35:1.
Purcell-modified fractions are not free-space constants; summation convention remains unresolved.

sources.title: Aruku Senoo et al.
sources.detail: High-fidelity entanglement and coherent multi-qubit mapping in an atom array
sources.referenceRole: Condition-specific measured Rydberg population and endpoint evidence; not target65S first-emission table
evidenceNotes: PDF p10 Methods and p18 ExtendedDataFig5: n about58, F1/2, typical8.2G; endpoint42(2)% ground and20(2)% 3P2F3/2 include cascade/readout assumptions.
m0/m1 mapping of2.7(5)% and4(1)% is opposite between Methods and figure; retained unresolved. 96/93% refer to detection of already-decayed events.

sources.title: Yue Wu et al.
sources.detail: Erasure conversion for fault-tolerant quantum computing in alkaline earth Rydberg atom arrays
sources.referenceRole: n75 radiative/BBR/cascade model assumptions for erasure conversion; not measured65S beta
evidenceNotes: SupplementaryNote2 pp1-3: n75, F3/2 approximate radiative+BBR model with isotope/HFS and omitted-channel limitations.
Modeled first departure, final cascade populations and erasure-detection fraction remain distinct.

sources.title: Lintao Li et al.
sources.detail: Parallelized telecom quantum networking with a ytterbium-171 atom array
sources.referenceRole: Independent experimental use of adopted low-state fractions; not independent branching measurement
evidenceNotes: PDF p9 AppendixA3 adopts .64/.35/.01 and acknowledges differing estimates.
PDF p14 TableI (SPAM parameters, not TableII) fixes 3S1->3P1 .367, ->3P2 .503 and 3D1 .35/.01 from previous theory/experiment. TableII is error budget.

sources.title: Taiki Ishiyama et al.
sources.detail: Orders-of-magnitude improvement in precision spectroscopy of an inner-shell orbital clock transition in neutral ytterbium
sources.referenceRole: Additional neutral174Yb inner-shell lifetime and environmental-decay model; outside current eight-state diagram
evidenceNotes: PDF p4 Fig2 and Eq1: at45Er per axis Gammae->g=.050(.002)Hz and Gammatot=.169(.010)Hz; loss, BBR, lattice scattering included.
Zero-scattering extrapolation Gammatot=.02(.04)Hz; authors quote tau66s with lower bound20s; preserve original inference, not simple reciprocal error propagation. Not a complete direct beta table.
